<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem</title>
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .grid { stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 1; }
    .triangle { fill: #e2e8f0; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .right-angle { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 2.5; }
    
    .sq-a { fill: #bfdbfe; stroke: #2563eb; stroke-width: 2.5; }
    .sq-b { fill: #fed7aa; stroke: #ea580c; stroke-width: 2.5; }
    .sq-c { fill: #bbf7d0; stroke: #16a34a; stroke-width: 2.5; }
    
    .grid-line-a { stroke: #93c5fd; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4 4; }
    .grid-line-b { stroke: #fdba74; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4 4; }
    .grid-line-c { stroke: #86efac; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4 4; }

    .title-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; fill: #334155; text-anchor: middle; }
    .formula-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .info-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; }

    /* SMIL animations via CSS keyframes */
    @keyframes pulseA {
      0%, 20% { opacity: 0.3; }
      30%, 60% { opacity: 1; stroke-width: 4px; }
      70%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseB {
      0%, 35% { opacity: 0.3; }
      45%, 75% { opacity: 1; stroke-width: 4px; }
      85%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseC {
      0%, 55% { opacity: 0.3; }
      65%, 95% { opacity: 1; stroke-width: 4px; }
      100% { opacity: 0.3; }
    }
    @keyframes showFormula {
      0%, 60% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); }
      70%, 95% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      100% { opacity: 0; }
    }

    .anim-a { animation: pulseA 8s infinite; }
    .anim-b { animation: pulseB 8s infinite; }
    .anim-c { animation: pulseC 8s infinite; }
    .anim-formula { animation: showFormula 8s infinite; transform-origin: 655px 385px; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" class="bg"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="40" class="title-text">Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- SQUARE ON SIDE A (Left, 3x3 units = 105x105) -->
  <!-- Top-Left: (155, 225) -->
  <rect x="155" y="225" width="105" height="105" class="sq-a anim-a" rx="4"/>
  <line x1="190" y1="225" x2="190" y2="330" class="grid-line-a"/>
  <line x1="225" y1="225" x2="225" y2="330" class="grid-line-a"/>
  <line x1="155" y1="260" x2="260" y2="260" class="grid-line-a"/>
  <line x1="155" y1="295" x2="260" y2="295" class="grid-line-a"/>
  <text x="207.5" y="282" class="label-text" fill="#1d4ed8">a² = 9</text>

  <!-- SQUARE ON SIDE B (Bottom, 4x4 units = 140x140) -->
  <!-- Top-Left: (260, 330) -->
  <rect x="260" y="330" width="140" height="140" class="sq-b anim-b" rx="4"/>
  <line x1="295" y1="330" x2="295" y2="470" class="grid-line-b"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="330" x2="330" y2="470" class="grid-line-b"/>
  <line x1="365" y1="330" x2="365" y2="470" class="grid-line-b"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="365" x2="400" y2="365" class="grid-line-b"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="400" x2="400" y2="400" class="grid-line-b"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="435" x2="400" y2="435" class="grid-line-b"/>
  <text x="330" y="405" class="label-text" fill="#c2410c">b² = 16</text>

  <!-- SQUARE ON SIDE C (Hypotenuse, 5x5 units = 175x175) -->
  <!-- Vertices: (260,225) (400,330) (505,190) (365,85) -->
  <polygon points="260,225 400,330 505,190 365,85" class="sq-c anim-c"/>
  
  <!-- Internal grid lines for Square C -->
  <line x1="281" y1="197" x2="421" y2="302" class="grid-line-c"/>
  <line x1="302" y1="168" x2="442" y2="273" class="grid-line-c"/>
  <line x1="323" y1="140" x2="463" y2="245" class="grid-line-c"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="112" x2="484" y2="218" class="grid-line-c"/>
  <line x1="312" y1="252" x2="408" y2="137" class="grid-line-c"/>
  <line x1="365" y1="280" x2="460" y2="164" class="grid-line-c"/>
  <line x1="248" y1="277" x2="343" y2="162" class="grid-line-c"/>
  <line x1="226" y1="250" x2="321" y2="135" class="grid-line-c"/>

  <text x="435" y="208" class="label-text" fill="#15803d" transform="rotate(37, 435, 208)">c² = 25</text>

  <!-- Triangle (drawn on top of square overlapping edges) -->
  <polygon points="260,225 400,330 260,330" class="triangle"/>

  <!-- Right angle marker -->
  <polyline points="260,310 280,310 280,330" class="right-angle"/>

  <!-- Triangle Side Labels (Spaced well away from shape interiors to avoid overlaps) -->
  <text x="135" y="282" class="label-text" fill="#1e293b">a = 3</text>
  <text x="330" y="490" class="label-text" fill="#1e293b">b = 4</text>
  <text x="305" y="240" class="label-text" fill="#1e293b" transform="rotate(37, 305, 240)">hypotenuse (c = 5)</text>

  <!-- Information Panel on the Right -->
  <rect x="530" y="70" width="250" height="390" rx="10" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="655" y="105" class="formula-text">Key Facts</text>
  
  <text x="545" y="145" class="info-text">• Longest side is the</text>
  <text x="565" y="165" class="info-text" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">hypotenuse</text>
  <text x="545" y="185" class="info-text">  (opposite right angle).</text>

  <text x="545" y="225" class="info-text">• Area of square A = 3² = 9</text>
  <text x="545" y="255" class="info-text">• Area of square B = 4² = 16</text>
  <text x="545" y="285" class="info-text">• Area of square C = 5² = 25</text>

  <line x1="550" y1="310" x2="760" y2="310" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Formula Highlight Box with Animation -->
  <rect x="550" y="330" width="210" height="110" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <g class="anim-formula">
    <text x="655" y="362" class="formula-text" fill="#2563eb">a² + b² = c²</text>
    <text x="655" y="398" class="formula-text" fill="#16a34a">9 + 16 = 25</text>
    <text x="655" y="425" class="info-text" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13px" fill="#0f172a">Theorem verified!</text>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a circle</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; font-family: sans-serif; fill: #1e293b; }
    .label { font-size: 16px; font-family: sans-serif; fill: #334155; }
    .formula { font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: sans-serif; fill: #0284c7; }
    .desc { font-size: 14px; font-family: sans-serif; fill: #475569; }
    
    @keyframes sweep {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    .sweep-line {
      transform-origin: 260px 260px;
      animation: sweep 8s linear infinite;
    }
    
    @keyframes orbit {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    .orbit-group {
      transform-origin: 260px 260px;
      animation: orbit 8s linear infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { r: 6px; fill: #0f172a; }
      50% { r: 9px; fill: #2563eb; }
    }
    .centre-dot {
      animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" class="bg" rx="12"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="title">Mathematical Properties: Parts of a Circle</text>

  <!-- LEFT SIDE: The Circle Diagram -->
  <g id="circle-diagram">
    <!-- Diameter (Horizontal Line) -->
    <line x1="100" y1="260" x2="420" y2="260" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>
    
    <!-- Outer boundary / Circumference -->
    <circle cx="260" cy="260" r="160" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="4"/>
    
    <!-- Animated Circumference Tracer (Point) -->
    <g class="orbit-group">
      <circle cx="420" cy="260" r="8" fill="#e11d48"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Radius (Rotating Line) -->
    <g class="sweep-line">
      <line x1="260" y1="260" x2="420" y2="260" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="4"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Centre Point -->
    <circle cx="260" cy="260" class="centre-dot"/>

    <!-- Labels for the Circle Parts (positioned clearly away from overlapping lines/shapes) -->
    
    <!-- Centre Label -->
    <line x1="260" y1="260" x2="210" y2="210" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="200" y="200" text-anchor="end" class="label" font-weight="bold">centre</text>
    
    <!-- Radius Label -->
    <text x="340" y="240" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold">radius</text>
    
    <!-- Diameter Label -->
    <text x="260" y="295" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#059669" font-weight="bold">diameter</text>

    <!-- Circumference Label (Moved safely outside top-right of circle with leader line) -->
    <line x1="373" y1="147" x2="440" y2="90" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="445" y="85" text-anchor="start" class="label" fill="#e11d48" font-weight="bold">circumference</text>
  </g>

  <!-- RIGHT SIDE: Information & Definitions Panel (Strictly bounded in X: 500 to 770) -->
  <g id="info-panel" transform="translate(500, 80)">
    <!-- Panel Background -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="270" height="360" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" rx="8"/>
    
    <text x="20" y="35" class="title" font-size="18">Key Definitions</text>
    
    <!-- Definition 1: Centre -->
    <circle cx="30" cy="75" r="4" fill="#0f172a"/>
    <text x="45" y="80" class="desc"><tspan font-weight="bold">Centre:</tspan> The fixed point</text>
    <text x="45" y="100" class="desc">right in the middle.</text>

    <!-- Definition 2: Radius -->
    <line x1="20" y1="135" x2="40" y2="135" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="50" y="140" class="desc"><tspan font-weight="bold">Radius:</tspan> Distance from</text>
    <text x="50" y="160" class="desc">centre to the edge.</text>

    <!-- Definition 3: Diameter -->
    <line x1="20" y1="195" x2="40" y2="195" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="50" y="200" class="desc"><tspan font-weight="bold">Diameter:</tspan> Distance across</text>
    <text x="50" y="220" class="desc">through the centre.</text>

    <!-- Definition 4: Circumference -->
    <circle cx="30" cy="265" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="45" y="270" class="desc"><tspan font-weight="bold">Circumference:</tspan> The</text>
    <text x="45" y="290" class="desc">distance all round.</text>

    <!-- Formula Box -->
    <rect x="15" y="315" width="240" height="35" fill="#f1f5f9" rx="4"/>
    <text x="135" y="337" text-anchor="middle" class="formula">diameter = 2 × radius</text>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Series circuit</title>
  
  <style>
    .wire { stroke: #2c3e50; stroke-width: 4; fill: none; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .component { stroke: #2c3e50; stroke-width: 3; fill: #ffffff; }
    .label { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; }
    .sublabel { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #e74c3c; font-weight: bold; }
    .info-title { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 18px; fill: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; }
    .info-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #34495e; }
    .electron { fill: #f1c40f; stroke: #d35400; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .panel { fill: #f8f9fa; stroke: #bdc3c7; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8px; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Info Panel (Right Side, completely separated x:500-780) -->
  <rect x="500" y="30" width="280" height="440" class="panel"/>
  <text x="640" y="65" text-anchor="middle" class="info-title">Series Circuit Rules</text>
  
  <text x="520" y="110" class="info-text">• Only one loop for current</text>
  <text x="520" y="135" class="info-text">  to flow through.</text>
  
  <text x="520" y="185" class="info-text">• <tspan fill="#d35400" font-weight="bold">Current</tspan> is the same</text>
  <text x="520" y="210" class="info-text">  everywhere (0.2 A).</text>

  <text x="520" y="260" class="info-text">• <tspan fill="#8e44ad" font-weight="bold">Voltage</tspan> is shared</text>
  <text x="520" y="285" class="info-text">  between components</text>
  <text x="520" y="310" class="info-text">  (6 V = 3 V + 3 V).</text>

  <text x="520" y="380" class="info-text">Animated charges show</text>
  <text x="520" y="405" class="info-text">steady electron flow.</text>

  <!-- Circuit Loop Rectangle (x:80 to 440, y:90 to 410) -->
  <rect x="80" y="90" width="360" height="320" class="wire"/>

  <!-- Components along the circuit -->
  
  <!-- Cell (Bottom wire, centre at x:260, y:410) -->
  <g transform="translate(260, 410)">
    <rect x="-40" y="-12" width="80" height="24" fill="#ffffff" stroke="none"/>
    <line x1="-35" y1="0" x2="-15" y2="0" class="component" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="-12" x2="-15" y2="12" class="component" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="-20" x2="15" y2="20" class="component" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="35" y1="0" x2="15" y2="0" class="component" stroke-width="4"/>
    <text x="-25" y="-22" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#e67e22">+</text>
    <text x="25" y="-22" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#e67e22">-</text>
    <text x="0" y="38" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Cell</text>
    <text x="0" y="-28" text-anchor="middle" class="sublabel">6 V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Lamp 1 (Top wire, centre at x:200, y:90) -->
  <g transform="translate(200, 90)">
    <rect x="-25" y="-25" width="50" height="50" fill="#ffffff" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="22" class="component"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="-15" x2="15" y2="15" class="component"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="15" x2="15" y2="-15" class="component"/>
    <text x="0" y="-35" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Lamp 1</text>
    <text x="0" y="-50" text-anchor="middle" class="sublabel">3 V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Lamp 2 (Top wire, centre at x:340, y:90) -->
  <g transform="translate(340, 90)">
    <rect x="-25" y="-25" width="50" height="50" fill="#ffffff" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="22" class="component"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="-15" x2="15" y2="15" class="component"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="15" x2="15" y2="-15" class="component"/>
    <text x="0" y="-35" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Lamp 2</text>
    <text x="0" y="-50" text-anchor="middle" class="sublabel">3 V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ammeter 1 (Left wire, centre at x:80, y:230) -->
  <g transform="translate(80, 230)">
    <rect x="-25" y="-25" width="50" height="50" fill="#ffffff" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="22" class="component"/>
    <text x="0" y="7" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50">A</text>
    <text x="-40" y="5" text-anchor="end" class="label">Ammeter</text>
    <text x="-40" y="23" text-anchor="end" class="sublabel">0.2 A</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ammeter 2 (Right wire, centre at x:440, y:230) -->
  <g transform="translate(440, 230)">
    <rect x="-25" y="-25" width="50" height="50" fill="#ffffff" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="22" class="component"/>
    <text x="0" y="7" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50">A</text>
    <text x="40" y="5" text-anchor="start" class="label">Ammeter</text>
    <text x="40" y="23" text-anchor="start" class="sublabel">0.2 A</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Visible Labels (clearly away from lines) -->
  <text x="260" y="465" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#2980b9">Voltage supplied by cell is shared</text>
  <text x="260" y="45" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#c0392b">Series Circuit: Current & Voltage</text>
  
  <!-- Current Flow Animation using <animateMotion> -->

    </circle>

    </circle>
    <circle r="5" class="electron">

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <style>
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.95); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.05); }
      100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.95); }

    @keyframes flow {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 24; }
      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }

    .sun-ray {
      transform-origin: 100px 80px;

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter - Solid, Liquid and Gas Particle Arrangement and Motion</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .box { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 2.5; rx: 12; }
    .title { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .caption { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .particle-solid { fill: #3b82f6; stroke: #1e3a8a; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .particle-liquid { fill: #10b981; stroke: #065f46; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .particle-gas { fill: #f59e0b; stroke: #92400e; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .heading { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    
    /* Solid vibration */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      25% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); }
      50% { transform: translate(1px, -2px); }
      75% { transform: translate(2px, 2px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    .vib-1 { animation: vibrate 0.4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .vib-2 { animation: vibrate 0.35s infinite ease-in-out; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .vib-3 { animation: vibrate 0.45s infinite ease-in-out; animation-delay: 0.2s; }

    /* Liquid gentle flow */
    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(5px, -4px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-4px, 3px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-6px, 4px); }
      66% { transform: translate(3px, -5px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .liq-1 { animation: flow1 3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .liq-2 { animation: flow2 3.5s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Gas fast movement */
    @keyframes gas-move-1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(55px, -45px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-35px, -70px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-60px, 30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-65px, 50px); }
      50% { transform: translate(45px, 60px); }
      75% { transform: translate(50px, -40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(40px, 60px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-50px, -30px); }
      75% { transform: translate(30px, -50px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .gas-1 { animation: gas-move-1 2s infinite linear; }
    .gas-2 { animation: gas-move-2 1.7s infinite linear; }
    .gas-3 { animation: gas-move-3 2.2s infinite linear; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="800" height="500"/>

  <!-- Main Title -->
  <text x="400" y="38" class="heading">States of Matter & Particle Arrangement</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">solid</text>
    
    <!-- Solid Particles (Regular grid, fixed positions with vibration class) -->
    <g transform="translate(42, 65)">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="0" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="30" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="60" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="90" cy="0" r="11"/>
      
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="0" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="30" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="60" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="90" cy="30" r="11"/>

      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="0" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="30" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="60" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="90" cy="60" r="11"/>

      <!-- Row 4 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="0" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="30" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="60" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="90" cy="90" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Close together</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Vibrate in fixed positions</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Regular arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LIQUID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(287, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">liquid</text>
    
    <!-- Liquid Particles (Close, irregular, sliding past) -->
    <g transform="translate(38, 60)">
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="15" cy="15" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="45" cy="12" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="75" cy="18" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="105" cy="14" r="11"/>

      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="25" cy="45" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="58" cy="42" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="88" cy="48" r="11"/>
      
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="12" cy="78" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="42" cy="72" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="75" cy="75" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="102" cy="78" r="11"/>

      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="28" cy="108" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="60" cy="105" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="90" cy="110" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Close together</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Move past each other</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Random arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== GAS ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(544, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">gas</text>
    
    <!-- Gas Particles (Far apart, fast straight-line movement) -->
    <g transform="translate(112, 130)">
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-1" cx="0" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-2" cx="-50" cy="-40" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-3" cx="55" cy="-35" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-1" cx="-40" cy="45" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-2" cx="45" cy="40" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-3" cx="0" cy="-70" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Motion trails / arrows for gas -->
    <g stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" fill="none">
      <path d="M 60 90 Q 80 70 100 80"/>
      <path d="M 170 80 Q 150 110 130 95"/>
      <path d="M 80 180 Q 100 160 120 175"/>
      <path d="M 160 200 Q 140 180 150 160"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Far apart</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Move fast in all directions</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Random arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer summary box -->
  <rect x="30" y="380" width="740" height="90" rx="8" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="400" y="410" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="bold" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">Summary of Particle Model</text>
  <text x="400" y="437" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14px" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">Particles in all states have energy and move, but the space and freedom of movement</text>
  <text x="400" y="457" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14px" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">change from solid to liquid to gas.</text>

</svg>
